intent.effect: Preserve the successful Honeycomb shelf wood engraving on the upright NameForm front while finding the coarsest low-loss mesh pitch.
intent.comparison_rule: All three fields use the same physical source coordinates, relief depth, wall, glyph, mask, and print orientation; only mesh pitch changes.
intent.human_gate: Select a pitch only after exact-slicer layer review and a physical appearance/tactility comparison.

process.material_scope: PETG family; exact printed product, color, and batch remain to be recorded by the operator
process.orientation: Coupon foot on z=0; all three textured faces are vertical and face -Y

mapping.image_u: model Z, descending as in the Honeycomb shelf wall mapping
mapping.aspect_policy: intentional reference texture mapping; no per-panel stretching
mapping.repeat_policy: same registered source phase in every field

required_mesh: texture fades to zero at panel boundaries and glyph footprint
required_human: wood family remains recognizable at the intended viewing distance
glyph is continuously bonded and legible
no objectionable tile seam, aliasing, snagging, or dirt-trapping roughness
selected pitch is judged under fixed light and at three viewing angles
